The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Morningfire]] led the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Vornskr Company]] in a '''rescue''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[O'reen]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] after the native [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[O'reenian]]s, took the crew of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Unidentified Republic military exploration ship|military exploration ship]] as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]; the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] had been combing the Unknown Regions for signs of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] supply planets when it had stumbled upon O'reen. In the fray, the [[Unidentified Magnus (Clone Wars rescue)|ruler]], or [[Magnus (title)|Magnus]], of O'reen was [[Death/Legends|killed]]. The following [[Unidentified Magnus (post-Clone Wars rescue)|Magnus]] vowed to return O'reen to isolationism as a result.<ref name="UR ">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
